blocks.text: The wait is over, Portrait of Britain Vol. 9 is now open for entries!
Real people. Real lives. Real faces. Since 2016, this award has asked photographers to share the stories of the people they meet every day: family members, local legends, and famous faces alike.

For volume 8, Alex Elton-Wall photographed 170 of his Lydbrook neighbours on a fly-tipped sofa that became a village-wide art installation whilst Jaiyana Chelikha photographed Jounaid, born and raised in the UK, on Dartmoor in a gandoura, a traditional North African robe, worn over streetwear.

From the entries, 200 portraits will be shortlisted and 100 will be named winners. Those 100 will be shown on JCDecaux UK digital screens across the country for a month from early January 2027, turning the British high street into a nationwide gallery.
BJP Members can enter up to 10 images for free, plus get digital access to the latest issue POLITICS on their Online Library.
